name: pc.notification-delivery-requested-receipt.v1
authorityRules: Only installed/current LS-CONTROL-WORK/ROLE-CONTROL-WORKER under SUB-EVIDENCEEXPORTCOMPLETED-CONTROL_WORK-V1 publishes the registered NotificationDeliveryRequested event. The exact already committed NotificationOccurrenceReceiptV1 and every immutable occurrence/payload/endpoint/key/source identity must match; no source event or human CREATE receipt grants this role. occurrenceReceiptDigest is SHA-256 of the exact canonical original occurrence receipt payload. The publication has its own distinct operationId and receiptId and cannot predate occurrence admission.

The event has type io.openpc.notification.delivery.requested.v1, canonical NotificationDeliveryRequested DATA with exactly notificationOccurrenceId, endpointId, templateDigest and payloadDigest, ordering key notificationOccurrenceId, and a distinct NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_REQUESTED_V1 sequence namespace beginning at 1. Source is urn:openpc:service:<installed sourceId>; subject is urn:openpc:notification-occurrence:<notificationOccurrenceId>. Sequence 1 is the only initial request for that original occurrence.

Data refs use urn:openpc:notification-occurrence:<notificationOccurrenceId> and urn:openpc:resource:<endpointId>; correlationId is the original worker operationId, causationId the original authenticated sourceEventId, timestamp recordedAtMs rendered with exact six-digit UTC fractional precision. The signed dataDigest binds the canonical four-key DATA CBOR, not JSON reserialization or the receipt itself. Canonical DATA map keys are 0=occurrence URN text, 1=endpoint URN text, 2=template digest H32 bytes, 3=payload digest H32 bytes; exactly four fields in ascending key order.

Prepared signer attempt, original receipt, operation result, exact source inbox acknowledgement and one distinct bound outbox event commit atomically before cursor advance. Publication cannot mutate the original occurrence/payload or replace its admission receipt. Concurrent replay returns the same IDs, sequence, signed bytes and event. An uncertain original remains unresolved until authoritative readback; a new key or request ID is not a new business intent.

This is durable delivery-request publication only; LS-NOTIFICATION independently authenticates its subscription, reauthorizes current delivery and reconciles the original occurrence before external I/O. Gateway credentials, attempt state, five bounded retries, ambiguous-send reconciliation, delivery completion, user acknowledgement and retirement remain separate.
